result:
I shipped nothing this run, because the two items I was going to build were already in the game.

The extract timer (37) shipped in v32.35, and the wheel focus wedge (61) shipped in v32.29, both by the lane b job (b-30). Item 78, the mixed 14px and 18px button text, I did not build. I only re-shot and judged the raid screens.

I took 7 pictures (screens 19, 21, 36, 37, 50, 61, 78) at 1080p, and the lint found nothing on any of them. I ran the critic on three of them:

| Screen | Score |
|---|---|
| 21 (calm) | 2 |
| 37 (extracting) | 2 |
| 50 (arcade) | 3 |

The pictures are in `notes/shots/c-02-r21`.

Most of the remaining critic findings are stuck on his orders or on older checks:
- **His orders:** the calm-state key legend ("always open on arrival") and the credits/xp/stash/backpack column.
- **Old checks that need retargeting first:** run info has two headings (check 27.42), and the ammo card colour check.
- **Not blocked:** the left status chips, the hp/stamina bars and the top clock plate each look like they could be fixed on their own, but I didn't try.

I've written the next steps into `notes\02-raid-hud-redesign.md`: one chip style for the left stack, drop the duplicate "5 items $" line on the ammo card, and use one run info heading. Past six tries the best versions stay c-02-r17, r18 and r21.

TASK PARTIAL: screens 21, 37 (at 2) and 50 (at 3) are below their finish line, and 19, 36, 61 and 78 weren't re-judged. Still to do: the three fixes above, after a short lock hold to retarget the old checks.

NEXT: build the left chip style fix with its check retargets, then re-shoot and judge screens 21 and 50.
